# Opting out

Run `queue.mjs frobnicate` here. <!-- prose-ok: -->
Run `queue.mjs teleport` here. <!-- prose-ok: an older pass still reads it -->
Run `queue.mjs vanish` here.

```bash
node ~/.claude/desk/bin/queue.mjs evaporate ABC-123   # prose-ok:
node ~/.claude/desk/bin/queue.mjs sublimate ABC-123   # prose-ok: kept for the migration
```
